Boil gently or mix in warm water for 5 minutes until aromas are fully released.
Strain thoroughly into a cup and allow to cool to a comfortable drinking temperature.
Stir in remaining ingredients like Soaked Almonds right before consuming.
usage: Take 1-2 times daily while experiencing water retention & swelling. Best consumed fresh.
warning: For mild symptoms only. Discontinue if stomach upset occurs. Consult doctor if symptoms persist beyond 48 hours.
